description: List the bookable areas/types for a restaurant (e.g. "Boka Inne", "Boka baren"). Returns each area's type id for use in the other availability tools.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

lang.description: Widget language code (e.g. en, se, da, de, fr). Defaults to en.

name: easytable_list_types
